subject: general
question: In 1600, the East India company acquired a charter from which ruler?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Queen Elizabeth-I__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The English East India Company was established on 31 December 1600 as per the Royal Charter issued by the **Queen of England, Elizabeth I**. 
 
• English company was formed for the purpose of trade with East and Southeast Asia and India. 
 
• The Company had sent Captain Hawkins to the court of the Mughal Emperor, Jahangir in 1608 to secure permission to establish a storehouse of goods at Surat. 
 
• In 1613, Jahangir issued the firman permitting the East India Company to establish its first trading post at Surat. 
 
• English set up business centres at Agra, Ahmedabad and Broach.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kaiser-I-Hind** means Empress of India was the Title given to **Queen Victoria i**n the year 1877 in Delhi Durbar by Viceroy Lord Lytton (1876-1880).
 
• In 1608, King James I of Great Britain sent Captain William Hawkings to the court of the Mughal emperor, Jahangir requesting permission to trade with them.
